command.reason: AI-assisted technical source review under the administrator's authorization, including an independent review workstream; not an external human audit. Exact submission source, protected build, compiler/input/bytecode and canonical host manifest checked. Reviewed the full constructor-valid configuration range, external dependencies, callback liveness/manipulation, budget/management roles and composition. Hosted smoke checks alone do not prove hot-path behavior; the exact host-profile tests supply additional coverage. Approval is for this immutable package and manifest; onchain publication, lifecycle/finality and public availability remain separate gates. The cap tracks gross purchases by calling actor, not person or token recipient. Sells do not restore capacity; separate wallets can bypass actor-level limits. It expires at the reviewed configured time and can include or exclude the initial buy. The module has no budget spending/refund action: retain fundable:false and zero funding in the host manifest and UI. Initial buys included in the cap must fit its gross amount. Reward credits roll back when this cap vetoes the combined trade.
